question: Does the saved WT external RNA/accessibility direction summary depend on unequal regions-per-gene representation or mapping assignments on common region support?
decision: Bound the representation and annotation explanation of the saved benchmark; no biological independence or mechanism conclusion.
strongest_rival: Genes with many annotated regions disproportionately determine pair-weighted agreement; changing annotation coverage or assignment can change the summary.
discriminator: Equal-gene mean of within-gene agreement versus saved pair-weighted agreement; all within-gene mixed ATAC directions; mapping assignments and direction classes on the exact common region intersection.
exposure_record: Original Nb-history/later-IAV paper context, all E1/E2 source qualification and transformed-mean results, human reports and follow-up feasibility are exposed. F1 newly summarizes the frozen non-infectious external WT benchmark; no outcome-unexposed confirmation.
biological_unit: Original source preparations within separate assays remain the biological units. Genes and regions are dependent descriptive features, not new biological replicates.
nesting_and_overlap: All results reuse the same frozen WT libraries and effects. Multiple mapped regions share genes, RNA effects and source libraries. Source preparation overlap and cross-assay pairing remain unqualified.
population_and_selection: Exactly the E2 offset1 eligible mapped membership under both frozen mapping rules and both existing distance subsets. No new distance, offset, expression or outcome selection.
contrast: Pair-weighted same-nonzero-direction fraction versus unweighted mean of each represented gene’s fraction; subtract pair-weighted fraction from equal-gene fraction. Separately compare assigned gene and same/opposite/zero direction class for common region IDs.
endpoint: Within-gene mapped-region counts, positive/negative/zero ATAC directions, same/opposite/zero fractions, mixed positive-and-negative ATAC indicator, aggregate weighting difference, exact common-support mapping contingency and annotation coverage.
methods: Read offset1 effects and saved membership only. Each gene’s agreement denominator includes all its mapped rows, including zero in either assay; such rows are classified zero, not agreeing. Equal-gene summary averages over represented genes. Report all candidate/eligible/mapped counts and all existing mapping/subset combinations. Compare mapping rules on region intersections separately by subset and report unique-to-rule counts. Independently verify with scalar dictionary counts and compare saved pair summaries exactly. Plot weighting and regions-per-gene empirical CDF without gene labels or ranking.
missingness_and_exclusions: No new exclusion or missing-as-zero. Stop on missing/nonfinite or duplicated effect keys, duplicated region keys within a mapping/subset, or lost membership joins. Keep zero and mixed directions. Source nearest-TSS subset is not proof of promoter mapping for the different Ensembl-assigned gene.
multiplicity: All four fixed mapping/subset summaries reported; no binomial tests, gene/peak independent-trial confidence intervals, locus ranking or selected targets.
precision_basis: Finite-set descriptive fractions over frozen dependent features. No sampling uncertainty inferred from numbers of genes or regions.
interpretation_limit: This bounds representation sensitivity within reused exposed external measurements. No independent replication, causal RNA-accessibility relationship, TF activity, absolute-output scale or original-study hold resolution.
stop_rule: Stop on hash, join, scalar verification or saved-summary discrepancy. Do not tune mappings, subsets or zero handling after new output exposure.
amendment_reason: Owner-authorized F1 adds representation diagnostics without changing or rerunning E2.
